Hero focus remains on the 'extra-wide' front paddles containing an unusually high number of digits (polydactyly), extended downward and fully flattened to the camera plane for clear volume and tracking analysis.

The angled, tight turn from the original reference is smoothed into a straight, level cruising path parallel to the frame edge to perfectly trace alongside the UI measuring tape system.
